chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan man in his early thirties, short black hair, neat short black beard, wearing a light blue oxford shirt with rolled sleeves and dark navy chinos
chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her mid twenties, big dark eyes, wearing a cream headscarf and a long burgundy dress with a thin gold belt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a small Moroccan notary office (adoul), the WIFE eagerly pulls the NARRATOR by the hand toward the desk with marriage papers, she looks hurried and excited, he looks surprised. Seen from the doorway, head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, main action in the centre.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A small simple Moroccan wedding in a modest living room, the WIFE in a caftan smiles eagerly and checks the time, the NARRATOR beside her looks a bit lost, a few relatives clapping in the soft background.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In front of an apartment building on the empty edge of a Moroccan town, the WIFE proudly holds up a key to the NARRATOR, who looks around at the far, empty street, puzzled. Both faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside a cosy newly furnished Moroccan flat, the couple laughs together on the sofa drinking mint tea, honeymoon happiness, warm evening light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The NARRATOR leans on the kitchen door frame, smiling dreamily as he watches the WIFE cook at the stove in the small kitchen, she does not look at him.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the living room, the WIFE stands shouting angrily with her arms crossed, pointing at the NARRATOR, who raises his hands, shocked. Faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The NARRATOR comes home tired holding his work bag in the doorway, while the WIFE lies on the sofa turned away from him, ignoring him, eyes half closed, a cold atmosphere.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the flat's entrance hallway, the WIFE in a long grey djellaba hurries out of the front door alone, glancing back, while the NARRATOR watches her from the far end of the hallway, curious. Seen from behind the narrator's shoulder, her face visible.
